question: A cross between a tall plant (TT) and short plant (tt) resulted in F1 progeny which were all tall plants because:

options.text: The plant height is governed by T and t
The plant height is governed by t only
The plant height is governed by T only
The plant height is governed by T or t

solution:
The correct answer is __**The plant height is governed by T or t**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A cross between a tall plant (TT) and short plant (tt) **resulted in all tall offspring because the plant height is governed by T only**
 
• This is an **example of a monohybrid cross**
 
• In** Mendelian genetics, the allele (TT) represents tallness and the allele (tt) represents shortness. **
 
• When** two traits of a character are cr**ossed, the (F₁₎ plants only show the dominant trait.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ae8821537f7860391e81403eebc4737b3f817e488db1d36a30e17c796b8cc401.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• '​Pure' plants refer to the homozygous condition in plants and 'hybrid' refers to the heterozygous plants.
 
• Homozygous - It is the condition in which the pair of alleles determining a phenotype is identical, either both dominant (TT) or both recessive (tt).
 
• Heterozygous - It is the condition where 2 different types of alleles are present, one dominant and one recessive (Tt).
 
• When a pure tall plant (TT) is crossed with a pure short plant (tt), the F1 generation produces heterozygous tall (Tt) plants.
 
• Upon selfing the F1 generation, that is, crossing two heterozygous tall plants, the following numbers of the F2 generation are obtained phenotypically:
 
 
• Three tall plants and one short plant
 
 
 
• Whereas, genotypically, the following ratio is obtained:
 
 
• One pure tall plant, two heterozygous tall plants, and one pure short plant.
 
 
 
• Therefore, considering the genotype, the ratio of pure tall plants to pure short plants in the F2 generation is 1:1
